name: AirPlay Mirror
author: Karl Løland
description: Discover AirPlay receivers and mirror the Omarchy desktop with DoubleTake.

barWidget.description: Discover, select, pair, start and stop AirPlay screen mirroring from the bar.

schema.label: DoubleTake executable
schema.description: Command name or absolute path to DoubleTake.

schema.label: Video codec
schema.description: H.264 is the most compatible choice for live desktop mirroring.

schema.label: Hardware encoder
schema.description: Use auto first. Intel graphics commonly work best with VAAPI.

schema.label: VAAPI driver
schema.description: Optional LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME, for example iHD on recent Intel graphics.

schema.label: UDP port range
schema.description: At least three local ports are required. Permit this range in the firewall for receiver addresses.

schema.label: Mirror audio
schema.description: Disabled by default while audio support in DoubleTake is experimental.

schema.label: Choose capture source every time
schema.description: Show the portal's screen/window/region picker for every new mirroring session.
